g.text: Named KiCad buses show complete grouped routes; member pin stubs carry exact net labels. RESET_N is an explicit Pico / Z80 / GAL three-way wire junction.

g.text: R1-R16: 5V fail-safe pulls. R17-R21: 3V3 pulls. R22-R28: GPIO pull-downs. R29-R31: MCP reset transistor bias.
